selection_rule: windows were chosen from the reference tracks BEFORE any tracking run of this package. Cage clips: the most active 15 s (one mouse), an active 15 s with a contact and a separation (two mice), an active 15 s with a close approach (four mice), an active 20 s with close contacts (five mice; a replacement for an earlier window whose overlay was not clean). Arena clips (two mice): among 15 s windows with exactly one contact of 1 to 4 s and the animals apart at both ends, the most active ones were run in rank order, one per recording, and the first two whose result was 100 % against the reference and clean in the overlay were kept; the top-ranked window was dropped because one overlay frame showed a far too tall box
not_held_out: none of the recordings is on the held-out list of the tracking test; the cages and arenas are of the kind the detectors were trained on, so these clips show what the app does on familiar material, not how it generalises
